text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, as I was 
cleaning up with Rhein Kraft—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Craft-san. You certainly seemed 
quite fired up today.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Did it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Did she look somewhat anxious to you as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday... there was something I 
couldn't quite do, so I guess I might've 
gotten a little too stubborn about it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's a good mindset, but... Just 
try not to push yourself too hard, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I just felt that if it wasn't right now, 
tomorrow would be too late... I don't 
understand it myself, but I got so 
worried..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... When anxiety threatens to 
crush you, and you just can't sit still. 
There are times like that, yes...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Times like that make you want 
to just dive right into training, don't 
they? I think that can help wipe away some 
anxieties too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You... think so? In that case, maybe I'll 
keep training... just a little bit longer?
choice_data_list:
Let's stop here. Any more would be 
overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep trying my best... until I'm 
truly satisfied with the result.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Try not to overdo it too much, okay?

I convinced her that without proper rest, 
her next performance wouldn't improve 
either.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose you're right. ...I'm sorry. 
It seems I was just getting ahead of 
myself.
choice_data_list:
I think you've worked hard enough for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that puts me a bit at 
ease... I'll do my best again tomorrow.
